title: Supramolecular engineering in hybrid perovskite optoelectronics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00924J, Review Article
Tzu-Sen Su, Anurag Krishna, Chenxu Zhao, Junhao Chu, Hong Zhang
This review emphasizes how supramolecular engineering enhances perovskite optoelectronics by improving crystallization, morphology, stability, and performance, offering insights into recent advances and future potential for commercial applications.
